title: Max value AND its position
prompt: Implement `int[] maxWithIndex(int[] values)` returning `{max, index}` of the FIRST occurrence of the largest value. Return `new int[]{-1, -1}` for an empty array.

tests.name: single peak
tests.hint: Track both value and position in one pass.

tests.name: ties keep the first
tests.code: CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.maxWithIndex(new int[]{5, 7, 7, 2}), new int[]{7, 1}, "first of the ties");
tests.hint: Strictly greater (`>`) updates; equal does not — first occurrence wins.

tests.name: empty array
tests.hint: The seed handles it: nothing beats the sentinel pair.
